scene.name: The Little Stormcaller
scene.text: On a hot afternoon, the Golden Child claps toward a distant cloud. Thunder answers. Rain drums on the village roofs. The boy looks pleased, then startled by the volume, and hurries under shelter with everyone else.

text_only.reason: rule 8: no game has weather; the rain is told only, and nobody is harmed
